children: stc Bahrain, a digital enabler, has signed a strategic reseller partnership with UiPath, announced at LEAP in Riyadh, to deliver enterprise-grade Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and cutting-edge automation technologies.

The partnership positions stc Bahrain as an end-to-end automation services provider, covering process discovery, workflow automation and advanced automation capabilities. It represents a major milestone in stc Bahrain’s expansion beyond traditional connectivity and infrastructure hosting, said a statement from stc.
The collaboration diversifies stc Bahrain’s managed services portfolio through advanced enterprise automation, opening new revenue streams across the enterprise and public sectors.

By providing end-to-end automation solutions, stc Bahrain said it will enable its business clients to significantly reduce operational costs, improve efficiency and streamline complex workflows, while reinforcing its position as a comprehensive digital transformation partner.

On the key milestone, stc Bahrain CEO Khalid AlOsaimi said: "Our partnership with UiPath marks a significant step in stc Bahrain’s digital transformation journey, enabling us to deliver enterprise-grade automation technologies that help our customers reduce costs, improve efficiency and accelerate their own transformation.”

Through this agreement, stc Bahrain continues to pave the way for next-generation enterprise solutions, driving digital maturity and operational excellence for organizations across Bahrain and the region, he added.

title: ZAWYA: STC Bahrain boosts enterprise automation sector with strategic UiPath deal
